value.rationale: Restricted-range transformation semigroups are a natural established object, and ranks of their idempotent elements distinguish regular strata. The sharp three-phase distribution supplies a full-image threshold, a critical family of nondegenerate corank probabilities and an exactly located second-derivative change in their exponential enumerator. This is a coherent infinite-parameter phase diagram, not an arbitrary isolated numerical slice; no major open problem or downstream application is claimed.
